module_logistics_followup.canonical_route: Physical compilation/workspace create and refresh call load_unit with the first search path as LoaderOptions::stdlib_paths only when explicitly selected. The tested named module runs check_asdl_module, check_asdl_signature on the C++-verified resolved signature, and check_asdl_graph on the canonical loaded graph. Fallback retains C++ checks. No direct SDK access to the private projection.
module_logistics_followup.diagnostics: At most one existing synchronous frontend diagnostic per failed call; record_error bounds stored/emitted text using ON1X_SDK_MAX_DIAGNOSTIC_TEXT_BYTES and preserves the canonical ID and location.
unsupported: No source/AST/dependency snapshot publication from a loader result with opaque ownership.
